Pothole repair delays in Alabama spark political debate ahead of local polls. Municipal workers have abruptly halted long-awaited road maintenance projects across the Alabama township near Klerksdorp, which the current administration appears to be quietly orchestrating as part of a calculated mayoral strategy to withhold essential road repairs from wards that traditionally vote for rival parties until residents fall back into line before election day.

Rural electrification delays in Cala linked to broader municipal tensions. Council moves to reissue flawed water bills in Alabama following system error. Dikatšego tša kabo ya meetse mo Pietermaritzburg di hlagišetsa pele kgatelelo ya dikago tša metheo pele ga dikgetho tša selegae. Oah gago kgahla, go timwa ga mohlagase diiri tše seswai ka go latelana mola o lefela masepala ka botlalo! Wow, yeka ukuphelela okuphelele, indle igobozela ngqo emgwaqweni omkhulu futhi! Cishe kwalandelelwa ngqo nasohlelweni lwemiphumela ebukhoma, njengendlela iDurban ephatha ngayo izimali zensiza kasipala, ngakho kufanele sihloniphe imithetho esemthethweni!

Ke belaela le ge nkabe o le khanseleara yo a rakilwego go tšwa Khayelitsha yo a dulago torp ya rena ya leswisining go se na mohlagase, molao o ile wa thibela ka semmušo dikopo tša morago tša kgetho tša kgethegile ka morago ga letšatši leo la mafelelo, e lego tše di swanetšego ka botlalo!

Oh brilliant, another lovely day steering through pothole grand canyons in our forgotten town! Oh kuhle kakhulu, ukulinda amahora amabili uthola amanzi ahlanzekile eloli eligqwalile! Oah go makatša, go rutha ka meetsi a leswe fela go tšwa mojako wa ka pele! Ke belaela le ge leloko la phathi ye e rakilwego le lebeletše dipoelo tše di phelago ka ntle, thušo ya phapoši ya dikgetho e latetse Karolo ya 35 ya Molao wa Dikgetho tša Masepala ka botlalo!

Oh kumnandi, olunye ukhukhula lombane wendle engahluziwe oludlula ngasesitolo sendaweni! Kodwa okungenani inqubo yethu yokhetho ihlelekile: okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya luka-2021, abavoti bomasipala basekhaya banikezwe ngokusemthethweni amaphepha amabili okuvota ahlukene—elilodwa likazibonelelo wesigodi nelilodwa lohlaka lweqembu lokumelelwa okulinganiselwe! Ngicabanga ukuthi ngisho nasezindaweni ezinjengeMhluzi noma edolobheni lethu elidelelwe, iIEC ilandela Isigaba 20 soMthetho Wokhetho Lomasipala ncamashi, njengoba kufanele!

Go be go thabiša kudu ge bafetoši ba masepala ba thoma go phunya mebila ya matlapana mo Mount-Coke bakeng sa dipeakanyo tše di tšhoni tša dipokotho ka matsatsi a mabedi pele ga ditlhopho tša 2021. Kuhle kanjani ukuthi ngenkathi ubulongwe kamasipala buvuza emigwaqweni ngaphandle kwama-RDP-houses aseMotherwell ngesikhathi sokhetho luka-2021, umthetho uphoqelela ubumfihlo obuphelele ngaphakathi ekamelweni lokuvota. Ngaphansi kwemithetho yokhetho yaseNingizimu Afrika, akukho mxhasi weqemzu noma isikhulu esingabuka ukuthi isakhamuzi simaka kanjani ibalula laso, futhi akukho mvoti ovunyelwe ukuthatha izithombe zevoti lakhe elifihliwe.

Kuhle kanjani ukuthi kuboniswe ikhono lezokuphatha ukuthi ubulongwe obuhlaza buvale imigwaqo kulo lonke elaseNgwelezane ngesikhathi sokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya luka-2021. Go be go le botse thata ka boenjiniere ge dipompo tša meetse tša masepala tša Booysens-Park di ka di mpa di kgapa ka nako ya maemo a tšhoganetšo a phodišo go pele ga ditlhopho tša masepala tša 2021. Go molaleng gore bafetoši ba rulagantše go tswalwa mo ga meetse go boloka batho ba rena ba le maemong ba eme molaong bakeng sa ditankana tša meetse tša masepala ka morago ga nako ya go kgaola ya 19:00, go netefatša gore baagi ba baipišegilego ba latelwa ke sebaka sa bona sa go vota.

Kwaba kuhle kanjani ukuthi umnyakazo uqinisekise ukuthi ukucishwa kukagesi okuhleliwe kufaka uMotherwell ebumnyameni njengoba nje iziteshi zokuvota zivulwa ngesikhathi sokhetho lukamasipala luka-2021. How marvellous that despite broken municipal streetlights and unpaved roads in Colesberg during the 2021 local elections, electoral law explicitly guarantees that any voter already standing in line at the official 21:00 cut-off time must be permitted to mark their ballot. Officials on the ground are legally required to process everyone in queue, regardless of how slowly cadres managed surrounding services.

How incredibly generous of municipal cadres to leave Ngwelezane without clean drinking water on election day in 2021, yet electoral legislation is clear that no political party has the authority to unilaterally postpone voting at a station. Only the Electoral Commission, under strict legal conditions, may seek judicial relief or adjust voting hours during severe operational disruptions.

Kuhle kanjani ukubonisa ukusebenza kahle kukamasipala ukushiya imigwaqo engakhanyisiwe nemfucuza engathathelwanga kuyo yonke iBooysens-Park ngesikhathi sokhetho lukamasipala luka-2021, yize imihlahlandlela ye-IEC inikeza ngokusemthethweni ukuvakasha kwamakhaya okuvota okukhethekile ukusiza izakhamuzi ezikhulile nabakhubazekile. Abavoti ababhalisile abafaka isicelo ngempumelelo kusengaphambili bangavotela emakhaya, besusa ukungaqiniseki kokuhamba ngomzimba ngosuku lokhetho.

How remarkably inconvenient that the commission chose to postpone the initial voter registration weekend citing health protocols in 2021. The movement likely engineered this delay to prevent unemployed youth living in peri-urban RDP-houses from registering, effectively locking angry voters out of the democratic process before they could hold local cadres accountable.

I am calling right now from my rural village because I saw factional fights within the local council destroy our service delivery, leaving 88% of the streetlights and electrical transformers in our traditional area intentionally disabled by municipal workers during election week while millions were wasted transferring equipment all the way towards Wonderboom instead of repairing the massive potholes on our village access road!

Ke tshwenyegile kudu ka diotswana tše mpe le hlokego ya meetse a hloekilego ka ward ya ka, fela ke bone baperesidente ba dikgetho sekolong sa rena sa motseng ba hlatholla gabotse go mang le mang gore ka tlase ga molao wa dikgotla wa Afrika Borwa, kgetho ya pele ka dikgetho tša kgethego e lotetšwe ka matla go bakgethi bao ba fihlelelago nyakego ya nywaga bao ba rometšego dikopo tša pele ka baka la go fokola ga mmele goba mešomo ya dikgetho, gomme dienvelope tšeo tša dikgetho tša kgethego di lotilwe ka tšhireletšo gomme di balwa mmogo le dikgetho tša tlwaelo!

Ka hara ward ya ka yeo re dulago ka tlase ga bolaodi bja setšo, ke bone diteraka tša meetse tša masepala di sa fihle le temoso ka dikgwedi tše tharo ka go latelana ka nako ya letšolo, gomme se se nthakgolla moya moo e lego gore go feta 60% ya diteraka tša meetse tše di abetšwego seleteng sa rena sa magae di sa letlelelwe di ile tšautššetšwa mafelong a marui a batho ba humilego bjalo ka Randburg, tša re šiile le matlwana a boithomelo a manamo a tletšego le dipeipi tše robegilego gaeita le ge kgetho ya pele e be e direga kgorong ya rena ya setšo!

Even though people in my ward were jubilant when voting ended yesterday because we desperately need better sewage management and reliable water supply, I saw the presiding officer follow proper legal procedure near Namakgale by signing the official results slip together with party agents and sticking a physical copy on the outer door of our traditional authority center for public inspection before transport!

I live in a traditional village where my ward has been in total darkness because ESKOM and the local council cut off electricity to exactly 78% of rural homes across our municipality for ten straight days leading up to the election, and as we wait here while the official ballot-count takes place at the local school, every single age-eligible resident in our village is sitting in the dark with spoiled food and raw sewage leaking into our yards!

Ke letša ke tšwa motseng wa ka ka tlase ga bolaodi bja setšo kgauswi le Namakgale ka gobane ke bone ka mahlo a ka ka bokae kgekgethe ya meetse a leswe e elelago ka tsela ye kgolo e fetago kgoro ya kgoši ka dibeke tše tharo, gomme gomakatša gore 85% ya tekanyetso ya meralo ya motheo ya meetse ya masepala wa lefelong la gešo e fetšetšwe ka sephiri ka ntle ga ward ya rena ya magae pele ga kgetho gore go lokiswe ditsela ka lefelo le lengwe mola tšhireletšo ya bana ba rena e beilwe kotsing ka botlalo ka go nwa meetse a noka a silafetšego!

I was standing outside our voting station at the traditional council hall in my ward last night worrying about our broken water pipes, but I saw firsthand that according to IEC rules, the ballot-count for our local voting district must happen right inside the voting station immediately after polls close at nine, and all party agents were present inside the room to ensure the safety and integrity of every single vote cast!

While factional tension was high and every political party alliance was arguing about who will fix our village roads and water shortages, I saw party agents correctly follow electoral law by submitting written objections on official IEC forms directly to the presiding officer before the local counting was finalized, exactly as specified in the regulations governing municipal elections!

I am speaking on behalf of my ward in the rural Eastern Cape under Chief Khumalo where I saw police fire teargas at peaceful residents who were blocking the main road yesterday because 90% of our village's disaster relief water tankers were diverted to private farms, and now as the political party alliance negotiates over council seats while our results are counted, our roads are so destroyed by potholes that even emergency vehicles cannot reach us!

Headline: IEC confirms results slips must be posted publicly outside every voting station. Staff at the municipal help-desk clarified that procedures in areas from KwaNobuhle to small dorps require counting summary forms to be displayed on the venue door immediately after tallying.

Headline: Party representatives permitted to escort ballot box transport vehicles to municipal depots. Legal rules across South Africa, from the Durban metro to Flagstaff villages, guarantee that party delegates may closely follow IEC vehicles carrying sealed boxes.

Setlhogo: Molaodi wa dikgetho wa KwaNobuhle o swaswitswe a tšeela dipepetla legorong la polasetiki la lebokisi la dipepetla ka morago ga meako e tšwelelago. Balebeledi ba nyamelegilego ba lebeletše ka poifo mola balaodi ba selegae ba thuba dikgokelo tša metšina e tala ka gare ga ofisi ya poraefete pele ga palo ya mafelelo go tlo tšwa dikgethong tša masepala tša 2021 e phethwa.

Headline: Colesberg election results slips discovered shredded behind local public facility. Upset community members who relocated from Sharpeville panicked after finding official counting sheets dumped near the municipal help-desk during the 2021 local government vote.

Headline: Vryburg ballot boxes vanished during night transport to local counting center. Serious security incidents caused chaos when trucks carrying sealed municipal vote containers were diverted towards a Mobeni facility without oversight.

Headline: Unsealed stembus boxes left unattended in Flagstaff bakkie overnight. Local voters in Flagstaff were left deeply alarmed during the 2021 ukhetho when sealed voting containers were abandoned in an open vehicle without IEC security.

Setlhogo: IEC e gatelela tshepetšo ya go bala dipepetla tša selegae go thibela mathata a tshireletšo ya phetišetšo ya dipepetla. Didirišwa tša thuto ya kgetho tša semolao tše di phatlalatšwago go tšwa Sharpeville go ya metseng ya magae di hlalosa gore mabokisi a dipepetla a balwa ka go lebanya mafelong a dikgetho go efoga diketsahalo nakong ya tsela.

Headline: Official guide outlines strict rules for securing stembus containers during local elections. Electoral regulations for ukhetho require that all plastic seal serial numbers on ballot boxes are logged and verified with party agents before and after voting in Cala.

Re tshepa maphodisa a rena a SAPS ao a lego mo lefelong gona bjale, efela re swanetše go dula re lebeletše le go nyaka gore voutu e nngwe le e nngwe e balwe.

Taba tša setšhaba, hle phatlalatsa lefoko gore batho ba kwešiše go diega mo! Go bala mo holong ya setšhaba ya Hlabisa go emišitswe ka metsotso e 45 morago ga 21:00 ka gobane balaodi ba dikgetho ba be ba dira tekanyo ya pampiri ya dikgetho ya kgapeletšo — go bapela dikgetho tše di sa šomišweng kgahlanong le lenaneo la babouti. Maloko a rena ao a šomilego ka thata diksepong tša ntlo le ntlo a gona ka gare ga holo mmogo le baemedi bohle ba makgotla. Re tshepa gogolo mogato wo wa tlhophiso wa IEC wa tlwaelo wo o tiišetšang gore voutu e nngwe le e nngwe e a tiišetšwa.
